facts.text: The module controls Keysight E4980A series Precision LCR Meters with the class KeysightE4980A
The accepted impedance measurement functions are CPD, CPQ, CPG, CPRP, CSD, CSQ, CSRS, LPD, LPQ, LPG, LPRP, LPRD, LSD, LSQ, LSRS, LSRD, RX, ZTD, ZTR, GB, YTD, YTR and VDID
The measurement function is set with ':FUNCtion:IMPedance <function>' and queried with ':FUNCtion:IMPedance?'
A setting is sent as a fixed command word followed by the value, for example f':FREQuency {frequency}'
A query is sent as a fixed query word, for example ':FREQuency?'
Boolean states are written as ON or OFF and read back as 1/ON or 0/OFF
The aperture command is ':APERture <mode>,<averages>', with the instrument spellings SHORt, MEDium and LONG, and the averaging rate is checked to lie from 1 to 256
The cable length is one of 0, 1, 2 or 4 metres
The exponent field accepts 2 or 3 digits
The correction method is written as SINGle or MULTiple
The data format command is ':FORMat:DATA ASCii' or ':FORMat:DATA REAL,64'
The trigger source is written as INternal, HOLD, EXternal or BUS
fetch_formatted queries ':FETCh:IMPedance:FORMatted?' and parses primary value, secondary value and a numeric status code
fetch_corrected_impedance queries ':FETCh:IMPedance:CORRected?' and parses resistance and reactance in ohms
The signal monitors fetch AC voltage, AC current, DC voltage and DC current from ':FETCh:SMONitor:VAC?', ':FETCh:SMONitor:IAC?', ':FETCh:SMONitor:VDC?' and ':FETCh:SMONitor:IDC?'
One error-queue entry is read from ':SYSTem:ERRor?' and get_all_system_errors stops when the code before the first comma is 0
abort sends ':ABORt' and returns the trigger system to idle
The DC bias state is set with ':BIAS:STATe <state>' and queried with ':BIAS:STATe?'
The DC bias voltage is set with ':BIAS:VOLTage:LEVel <voltage>' and queried with ':BIAS:VOLTage:LEVel?'
The raw SCPI socket port is 5025 and a VISA resource is 'TCPIP0::<ip>::5025::SOCKET' or 'TCPIP0::<ip>::INSTR'
